svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Geist', 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Reads X-ray, CT and MRI. Outlines every finding. Explains each outline.
A 31B vision-language model I fine-tuned end to end on one DGX Spark:
Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B writes the report, a [SEG] token per finding drives
SAM 2.1 to draw the outline, and every number in the evidence is
measured from radiologist masks. Trained only on commercially licensed

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
